notes.title: We have update for the game!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28151092/b13ac1cc2875e36db8a8210d45a1c892074d0e56.png[/img]

Hi guys!

We did some updates to Deathmatch, like adding shields. Now we have new update which includes following things:

-Player is taken now directly to the Deathmatch scene to wait for other players
-When waiting for other deathmatch players, orbs are spawned to keep you busy
-Added 3 new achievements
-Tweaked enemy behaviour

Have fun!
